mapper.insert: insert into location_trust_fix (member_id, session_id, kind, ref_id, lat, lng, accuracy_m, client_ts, received_at, simulated, accessory, speed_mps, decision, applied_decision, reasons, detail) values (#{memberId}, #{sessionId}, #{kind}, #{refId}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{accuracyM}, #{clientTs}, #{receivedAt}, #{simulated}, #{accessory}, #{speedMps}, #{decision}, #{appliedDecision}, #{reasons}, #{detail})
mapper.select: select lat, lng, received_at as receivedAt, client_ts as clientTs, accuracy_m as accuracyM from location_trust_fix where member_id = #{memberId} and received_at >= #{since} and decision = 'ACCEPT' and (simulated is null or simulated = 0) order by received_at desc, id desc limit 1

select lat, lng, received_at as receivedAt, client_ts as clientTs, accuracy_m as accuracyM from location_trust_fix where member_id = #{memberId} and received_at >= #{since} and decision = 'ACCEPT' and (simulated is null or simulated = 0) order by received_at asc, id asc limit 1
select lat, lng from location_trust_fix where member_id = #{memberId} and session_id = #{sessionId} and kind = 'REVEAL' and decision = 'ACCEPT' order by id desc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from roam_fog_tile where member_id = #{memberId} and revealed_at >= #{since}
mapper.update: update location_trust_fix set detail = #{detail} where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from location_trust_fix where received_at < #{cutoff} order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into location_claim_evidence (member_id, place_ref, place_lat, place_lng, capture_source, photo_sha256, photo_phash, photo_taken_at, photo_lat, photo_lng, fix_id, verdict, reasons, duplicate_of, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{placeRef}, #{placeLat}, #{placeLng}, #{captureSource}, #{photoSha256}, #{photoPhash}, #{photoTakenAt}, #{photoLat}, #{photoLng}, #{fixId}, #{verdict}, #{reasons}, #{duplicateOf}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from location_claim_evidence where id = #{id} and member_id = #{memberId}
select * from location_claim_evidence where photo_sha256 = #{sha} and create_time >= #{since} order by id limit 20

select id, member_id as memberId, place_ref as placeRef, bit_count(photo_phash ^ #{phash}) as distance from location_claim_evidence where photo_phash is not null and create_time >= #{since} and not (member_id = #{memberId} and place_ref <=> #{placeRef}) order by distance asc, id asc limit 1
mapper.update: update location_claim_evidence set consumed_at = #{now}, consumed_ref = #{consumedRef} where id = #{id} and member_id = #{memberId} and verdict = 'ACCEPT' and consumed_at is null
update location_claim_evidence set consumed_at = #{now}, consumed_ref = #{consumedRef} where id = #{id} and member_id = #{memberId} and verdict in ('ACCEPT', 'REVIEW') and consumed_at is null
